translations.不可破壞的固定障礙。: A permanent obstacle that cannot be destroyed.
translations.水泡已放置，注意十字水柱。: Bubble placed. Watch out for the cross-shaped blast!
translations.水泡自行消散，無傷復原。: The bubble faded. You recovered without losing a life.
translations.水晶盾展開，獲得 3 秒防護。: Crystal Shield activated. Protected for 3 seconds.
translations.可被水柱炸毀，可能掉落道具。: Can be destroyed by a water blast and may drop an item.
translations.可進入已通過的關卡，以及目前進度的下一關。: You can revisit cleared stages or enter the next unlocked stage.
translations.目前已騎乘極速烏龜。: You're already riding the Speed Turtle.
translations.目前不需要使用救援針。: You don't need the Rescue Needle right now.
translations.立即脫困並獲得短暫防護。: Break free instantly and gain brief protection.
translations.先熟悉十字水柱。打倒兩隻巡邏蝙蝠。: Learn how the cross-shaped water blast works, then defeat the two patrolling bats.
translations.在狹窄路線中追蹤玩家。: Chases the player through narrow corridors.
translations.困在水泡中時不能放置水泡。: You cannot place another bubble while trapped.
translations.困泡時無法搭乘烏龜，請使用救援針或水晶盾。: You cannot mount the turtle while trapped. Use a Rescue Needle or Crystal Shield.
translations.使用 WASD 或方向鍵在格子間移動。: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move between tiles.
translations.怪物數量增加。破壞箱子，尋找水量與氣囊升級。: More monsters appear here. Break crates to find range and capacity upgrades.
translations.花園關卡中的固定障礙。: A permanent obstacle found in the garden.
translations.按下 Space 放置水球；倒數結束後會向四方爆發水柱。: Press Space to place a water bubble. When the timer ends, it bursts in four directions.
translations.突破五個區域，阻止海盜空港的入侵！: Clear five zones and stop the pirates from invading the skyport!
translations.耐久較高，接近時要小心。: Tougher than other enemies. Approach with care.
translations.氣囊已用完，等水泡爆開後再放置。: All bubbles are in use. Wait for one to burst before placing another.
translations.狹窄通道與巡邏敵人。盾牌能擋下水柱與碰撞。: Navigate tight corridors and patrolling enemies. Shields block blasts and collisions.
translations.基本攻擊，放置後產生十字形水柱。: Your basic attack. Place a bubble to create a cross-shaped water blast.
translations.救援針刺破水泡，立刻脫困。: The Rescue Needle popped the bubble. You're free!
translations.移動敏捷，會在通道間巡邏。: Moves quickly and patrols the corridors.
translations.被水柱困住 2 秒，期間仍可移動但不能放水泡。: Traps you in a bubble for 2 seconds. You can still move, but cannot place bubbles.
translations.被困進水泡！仍可移動，快甩開敵人或使用救援道具。: Trapped in a bubble! Keep moving to shake off the enemy, or use a rescue item.
translations.最終首領需要承受三次水柱。先清掉兩側護衛。: The final boss takes three water blasts to defeat. Clear the guards first.
translations.提升同時可放置的水球數量。: Increases the number of bubbles you can place at once.
translations.提升移動速度，可替角色抵擋一次攻擊。: Boosts movement speed and blocks one hit.
translations.損失 1 條命，已返回出生點並獲得 2 秒防護。: Lost 1 life. Returned to the starting point with 2 seconds of protection.
translations.搭乘極速烏龜：移速提升 20%，並可抵擋一次傷害。: Speed Turtle mounted: movement speed +20% and blocks one hit.
translations.極速烏龜擋下這次傷害，角色沒有困泡或扣命。: The Speed Turtle blocked the hit. No trap and no life lost.
translations.解救泡泡困住的角色。: Frees a character trapped in a bubble.
translations.需要啟用 JavaScript 才能遊玩 Splash ADV。: JavaScript must be enabled to play Splash ADV.
translations.增加水柱向四方延伸的格數。: Extends the water blast by one tile in every direction.
translations.敵人會沿路巡邏，靠近且路線暢通時才會追擊。: Enemies patrol their routes and only chase when you're nearby with a clear path.
translations.確定要重置所有關卡進度嗎？通關紀錄與最佳時間將被清除，且無法復原。: Reset all stage progress? Clear records and best times will be permanently erased.
translations.避開爆炸，消滅所有敵人並完成關卡。: Avoid the blasts, defeat every enemy, and clear the stage.
translations.Asteria、Lumi 與 Nyx 的水都冒險主視覺: Key art of Asteria, Lumi, and Nyx's Aquapolis adventure
translations.Asteria、Nyx 與 Lumi 的水泡救援行動。突破五個區域，阻止海盜空港: Join Asteria, Nyx, and Lumi on a bubble rescue mission. Clear five zones and stop the pirates from invading the skyport!
translations.生命歸零。重新整備後再出發。: Life returns to zero. Rearrange and set out again.
translations.道路已清出，下一個區域可以進入。: The path is cleared and the next area is accessible.
